what.text: This page follows refugees from Sri Lanka in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 148369 refugees from Sri Lanka.
India hosts the largest share, 60.3%, followed by France, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Eelam territory in Sri Lanka from 1984 to 2001, in 2003 and from 2005 to 2009, with the LTTE, at war level in many of those years.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Sri Lanka with the JVP in 1989 and 1990.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1985 at 160 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 209349, at the end of 1991, and was lower by the end of 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1990 to 1992 and 1994 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, and the data shows large jumps between 1987 and 1990.
